correctness.rationale: Direct determinant expansion yields eq. (1), with critical manifold S and Hessian determinant -16(s²-4)²(t²-4)². The determinant is nonzero for every stipulated parameter; the holomorphic Morse-Bott lemma gives transverse A1. Its reduced Milnor cohomology is rank-one in degree two. The global square root 4i(s²-4)(t²-4) trivializes the complex orthogonal orientation double cover, hence the integral vanishing-cycle local system along S. An A1 link is RP³, establishing the rational homology manifold consequence. The independent symbolic algebra re-evaluates the determinant from the matrix; there is no inference from finite samples.

value.rationale: The locus S is the geometrically distinguished entire open accidental rank-four stratum in a special-trace determinantal model of five-punctured character data. A uniform transverse singularity classification and especially its global integer vanishing local-system monodromy answer natural, precise singular-topology questions on a non-simply-connected stratum. The square-class computation rules out nontrivial sign twisting and implies rational smoothness there. This is more than a mere critical-point test or an arbitrary small parameter slice. It does not purport to provide a global smoothing invariant.
